name: segmented-text-field
description: The shared segment base: a row of editable segments, each its own rounded cell. date-field, time-field and date-picker copy this anatomy rather than reference it.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Unstyled root that holds the row of segments.

anatomy.name: segment
anatomy.description: One editable piece of a structured value, drawn as its own rounded cell (RSP DateSegment, 2px radius).

anatomyReview.notes: Owner decision A9 (2026-11-20): this component is the shared segment base that date-field, time-field and date-picker copy. No Figma page of its own. The root container is unstyled; the rounding sits on segment (RSP DateSegment radius 2px). The deprecated gap record is a frozen archive.
